title: Spine OS — Wizard EULA Consent Record (v1)
description: Local-only record written by the wizard splash/consent ceremony (§3.8a) before any business logic runs. Nothing is transmitted; this file lives on the operator/client machine for audit. Produced after a hard ACCEPT gate over the scrolled EULA.

accepted.description: MUST be true to proceed; false/absent => wizard halts at the gate.

accepted_at_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the ACCEPT action.

eula_sha256.description: Hash of the exact EULA text shown, so the accepted wording is reproducible.

template_version.description: Version of ecosystem-disclosures-template used to assemble the EULA.

machine_id.description: Stable local machine identifier (OS machine GUID or hashed hardware id). Local only.

_governance.gate: DRAFT — not legal advice. EULA text requires Australian-lawyer sign-off before any live/transacting use.
_governance.storage: Write inside the selected Spine OS root only (for example ~/SpineOS/consent-record.json). Never POST the consent record to a server.
_governance.immutability: Append-only: a re-accept on a new EULA version writes a new record; never overwrite a prior one.
